g.text: Left: losses integrated along the simulated ascent of the 4-panel ascent figure (ideal Δv = Σ vₑ ln(m₀/m_f), vacuum Isp).
Right: GTO perigee 200 km, inclination = site latitude; the apogee burn circularises and removes the inclination. Surface speed = 465 m/s × cos(latitude).
